target: Whole-neighbourhood visual coherence in a local, walkable realtime scene.
reference: assets/reference.png: original moderate-complexity rain-after-dusk canal street image.
baseline: SPACE08 model/layout and its live viewer; original scene/versions retained.
intent: A quiet inhabited canal street after rain, with a warm bookshop centre and a coherent surrounding district.
fixed: Existing dusk sky and identity of the bookshop
23 replacement tree positions and lower trunk collision coordinates
changes: Reduce large regular roof colour patches; use small staggered slate/tile courses with restrained relief.
Use material ageing tied to eaves, sill runoff and wall feet rather than arbitrary large dirty circles.
Replace solid polygon canopy clusters with visible branch hierarchy and fine cutout leaf sprigs.
Keep soil/grass subdued but differentiated at damp banks, slopes and district edges.
Lower overly bright local wall lamps while softly supporting the unlit sides with the existing sky light.
Keep separate responses for rough wet stones and dark reflective canal water; do not polish all surfaces alike.
constraints: No downloaded assets or new Blender model export
No extra reflection or shadow passes
Existing geometry/UVs unchanged except runtime tree replacements
notClaimed: Photographic fidelity, production-quality game assets or complete interiors.
